chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Harun ibn Muslim, from Mas'ada ibn Sadaqa, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) and he was asked about disbelief (kufr) and association (shirk), which of the two occurred earlier? So he said: Disbelief occurred earlier, and that is because Iblis was the first to disbelieve, and his disbelief was not association (shirk), because he did not call to the worship of other than Allah, and rather he called to that afterwards, so he associated (committed shirk).
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between kufr and shirk according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies the chronological precedence of kufr over shirk by analyzing Iblis's rebellion, noting that his initial refusal to prostrate was an act of pure disbelief (kufr) rather than polytheism. This distinction highlights that shirk, defined here as calling others to worship alongside Allah, emerged subsequently, establishing a theological hierarchy where denial of divine command precedes the attribution of partners to God.
